capabilities: Render .org files with headings, TODO badges, tags, dates, lists, tables, blocks and footnotes
Edit Org source in a CodeMirror editor with syntax highlighting, folding and Org-style keys
Create new .org files from the ribbon, folder menu or command palette
Follow file and heading links between Org files inside the vault
Typeset LaTeX math with Obsidian's MathJax
disambiguation: Despite the name, it is not read-only: a button and commands switch to a full Org editing mode.
extras: Not yet in the community plugin list; install via BRAT (ESeNonFossiIo/obsidian-org-reader) or manually copy release files. Only one plugin can claim the .org extension, so Orgmode (cm6) must be disabled first; the plugin shows a startup notice if the extension is taken.
intentEvidence: it does not depend on any other Org plugin and replaces Orgmode (cm6)
problem: Obsidian only renders Markdown, so .org files in a vault appear as plain text with no structure, formatting or Org-aware editing.

relations.evidence: it does not depend on any other Org plugin and replaces Orgmode (cm6)
Other plugins (such as Org Journal) can extend the editor through view.codeMirror.

summary: Org file viewer and editor that renders .org files with headings, TODO keywords, tags, tables and math, plus a CodeMirror editor with Org keybindings.
